title: 75-4 单排及多排主面墙面组
current_evidence_scope: 注意：这里先对重建面片做了缝合/裁剪/延伸，再执行普通圆角；原始重建模型保留在中栏。OCC 实际圆角 · R = 1 mm · 通过几何及导出校验。原图特殊模式尚未验证；选边与外形待人工核对。

generic_oracles.quantity: support geometry + finite domains + topology class
generic_oracles.method: Compare independently sampled supports/boundaries, dimensions, placements and material-side occupancy; account for allowed face subdivision. No widening, thickening or pruning source faces.

generic_oracles.expected: exactly requested faces/edges, no silent reselection
generic_oracles.method: Resolve geometric/topological selectors after import; record candidates and expected match count; ambiguous target stops score.
Native checks plus independent seam and occupancy/orientation tests. Save raw BRep even on failure.
Evaluate shared edge and both support surfaces using actual pcurves; sample endpoints/interior and adaptive extrema.
Use consistent material/sheet orientation and evaluate normals at actual seam; end caps only exempt from G1 if declared, never from G0.

target_change: Keep identical partitioned wall geometry while changing master face selection; reproduce the pass-through-both, pass-through-one, pass-through-neither conditions.
Where explicitly requested and supported, disable master-face requirement and show formerly excluded solution separately.
must_preserve: Input partition edges and multiple rows are real topology and cannot be removed by same-domain unification before selector testing.
Master blue color is selection metadata, not a new piece or a material face.
Do not infer every supplied face must be touched by the blend; PDF says at least one master, not all wall faces.

semantic_target.A: three columns along local x intervals [-12,-7],[-7,7],[7,12]; one row of wall z[0,18] and floor y[0,16], placed x=-20
semantic_target.B: same columns; wall rows z[0,7],[7,18] and floor rows y[0,7],[7,16], placed x=+20
semantic_target.masters: Face identified by original local column/row bounds. Do not identify by post-import numeric face index.

required_modes.expected: success with actual rails touching both nominated masters
success touching at least one nominated master
same geometric blend may be allowed

diagnostic_parameters.hit_rows: For a controlled R4 plane pair contacts lie in near row0..7; select far-row masters for neither-hit. Freeze exact columns and mode requests before execution.

feature_oracles.expected: all source partitions and IDs available before operation
feature_oracles.method: Check input support/face-domain adjacency graph; no simplify/removeSplitter before resolving master selectors.

feature_oracles.quantity: actual rail/transition footprint on nominated finite master faces
feature_oracles.expected: at least one master hit for master-on modes
feature_oracles.method: Project actual rail samples onto original face domains; additionally intersect actual rail with master interiors to handle boundary ambiguities.

feature_oracles.expected: reject or explicitly report unavailable policy mapping
feature_oracles.method: Report geometry correctness separately from vendor policy semantics; a valid blend that ignores masters is not proof that requested master option was honored.

native_paths.entry: SmFilletExecutive native topology filleting with face adjacency
native_paths.evidence: SMLib/inc/SmFilletExecutive.h; src/SmFilletExecutive.cpp uses target BRep and per-edge solvers
native_paths.expresses: Can traverse partitioned topology and produce baseline fillet
native_paths.boundary: No inspected master-face-first-array policy equivalent demonstrated. Do not call native geometry wrong solely because SMLib lacks Parasolid-specific policy.

native_paths.entry: SmSurfaceSurfaceFS native surface pair seed selection
native_paths.expresses: Provides UV seed guesses on two surfaces
native_paths.boundary: Seed is not a verified master-face eligibility switch for two arbitrary face sets.

gaps.description: No current bridge mapping of left/right face sets, master eligibility and master-off behavior. Must state policy unimplemented instead of reporting universal unsupported.
Original blue-face coordinates are schematic; controlled row/column master IDs and R must be frozen before exact positive/negative verdict.

inconsistent_if: Input partitions are collapsed to two planes.
One ordinary R1 result is reused for all master choices.
Needlessly requires both masters or every wall face to be touched.
Master-on neither-hit is reported source-mode success without acknowledging ignored policy.
